jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text: WindBorne is an atypical hardware company: we sell the data our balloons produce, not the balloons. Our customer is our own operations team, which puts engineering and the field about as close together as they can get. We push design changes to flying hardware roughly once a week while scaling production at the same time. Today every part of that loop is owned by full-stack engineers who each design a part, own its tooling, and tweak it based on field performance. That has worked so far, but manufacturing throughput and tooling maintenance have grown into a full-time load that can no longer share a desk with design iteration. This role exists to take that load. Manufacturing and Production turns engineering designs into repeatable, high-quality production. We build mechatronic hardware assemblies — PCBA, electronic sensors, ballast, and an adjustable inflatable balloon. Boards arrive populated from our suppliers. On our floor, we assemble the PCBAs into the electronics assembly, test it, and then build up the mechanical hardware, ballast, and balloon around it. The work is manual to semi-automated, and it has to hold together while the designs underneath it keep changing. We are running about 1,000 units a month and doubling roughly every six months. Most hardware teams get design lock before volume. We don't, and the manufacturing system has to work anyway. Own manufacturing engineering for parts as they come off the design team. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning Systems
jobs.description_text: WindBorne Systems designs, manufactures, and operates Atlas, a global constellation of smart weather balloons. The atmospheric observations they collect help drive WeatherMesh, our AI weather model https://windbornesystems.com/blog/introducing-wm-6. Our model, WeatherMesh, runs 24/7, producing global forecasts every hour. Our deep learning research team is small and iterates quickly, but sometimes R&D gets ahead of the internal tools that support it. We’re looking for a talented and curious software engineer to keep model inference running reliably, process atmospheric data as it arrives, and build tools that show us what’s happening in both. In this role, you’ll work with our deep learning team and backend and frontend engineers. We have problems for you to tackle right away, and we also want someone with ideas about what to build next. You’ll help figure out what’s needed, build it, and be responsible for how it works once it’s running. Prior machine learning experience is not required! You can come in with no ML background at all and be successful. Where you lack understanding, you’ll dig into model code, ask researchers questions, and use AI tools to get up to speed. Essentially, learn what you need to build and go build it. We care much more about how well you learn and your approach to problem solving than whether you have RAG or LLM fine-tuning on your resume. 关于我们

安贤投资（AXQ Capital）是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。

 

岗位使命

岗位职责

  • 计算集群与任务调度：参与建设和优化 GPU/CPU 集群、资源管理与任务调度系统，支持模型训练、特征计算及量化研究，提高资源利用率与多用户环境下的运行效率。

  • 机器学习平台与研究工具：建设开发环境、任务提交、实验管理、依赖与镜像管理等平台能力，提升研究过程的可复现性和实验迭代效率。
  • 训练与推理基础设施：支持模型训练、批量及在线推理任务的部署和运行，完善环境交付、版本管理、监控及故障恢复流程。
  • 自动化与稳定性建设：通过代码和自动化管理基础设施，完善监控告警、权限隔离、资源配额与容量管理，持续提升系统的可靠性和可维护性。

jobs.department: Autonomous Vehicles / Motion planning / Offline testing

About the team

Avride builds autonomous driving technology for vehicles and delivery robots, and tests it on public roads in Austin. Before anything reaches those roads it goes through our QA team: checks on every pull request, a daily validation of main, and release-candidate qualification over a large set of recorded scenes. Every one of those gates produces a verdict, and the safety part of that verdict is the one people act on.

About the role

You will own how safety is tested, judged and reported across our QA team. Our Head of Safety owns the company's safety framework and the safety case built on top of it. You own the layer beneath: the gates, the criteria and the reports that turn day-to-day testing into evidence that argument can rest on.

The hard part of this is not the collisions. Those are obvious, and nobody argues about them. It is everything short of a collision  the near miss, the late brake, the hesitation at an intersection that looked wrong to one engineer and fine to another where the judgement has to be made and then made the same way again next week, by someone else, on a different run. Turning that into criteria a whole team applies consistently is the craft of this role.

You will lead through process and through people who do not report to you.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer - Metrics Quality
jobs.department: Autonomous Vehicles / Motion planning / Offline testing
jobs.description_text:
Senior Test Engineer - Metrics Quality

About the team

Every decision Avride makes about its autonomous driving software  merge or revert, ship or hold, this approach or that one — rests on a metric computed over a set of recorded scenes. Our QA organization is what stands between a metric and a decision made on a metric that was quietly wrong.

About the role

You will own the quality of the metrics themselves. Our data scientists build them; you decide whether they can be trusted, before anyone starts making release decisions with them.

This is a specific and underrated craft. A metric can be computed correctly, pass every unit test, and still be the wrong number for the decision it is meant to support. Finding that takes reading the implementation, understanding the product, and knowing what the people who rely on the number are actually trying to learn from it.

The hard half of the job is not checking that a metric fires when it should. It is finding the places where it stays silent and should not have — the failures that produce no number at all, and therefore no complaint, until someone ships on the strength of them.
